summary: First testing pass for Velocity Atlas landing page. Backend: 4/4 pytest tests passed (health, inquiry create + email validation, favorites idempotency + list + delete + 404). Frontend: All primary flows functional — home hero + brand grid (10 cards), brand carousel with prev/next + dots, See Details -> car detail with color swatches, gallery thumbs, 3D viewer, About page with 10 founders + 10 brands + 30 car index entries, Contact form (empty submit blocked, valid submit shows 'Saved/success'), Favorites flow (add on brand page -> appears in /favorites -> remove works).

issues: React hydration warning: <a> nested inside <a> — an inner Link (data-testid=index-car-*) is rendered inside an outer Link (data-testid=index-brand-*) row. Not user-visible but produces console error and invalid HTML. Consider replacing outer wrapper with a non-link container or making inner car names non-Link and letting the whole row navigate to brand, or vice versa.

action_items: Fix nested <a> inside <a> on About page index (Link inside Link) to remove hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/inquiries and /api/favorites POST return 200 by default; consider 201 Created for RESTful correctness (non-blocking).
server.py stores created_at as ISO string in Mongo then converts back on read — works, but storing as native datetime would be cleaner.
AboutPage: nested Link components produce invalid HTML (a-in-a) and React hydration warnings.
seed_data_creation: None; test data uses TEST_ prefixed session_id and inquiry names; favorites cleaned up in test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints all working. Frontend all data-testids resolve correctly. Only outstanding issue is About page nested Link causing React hydration warning — cosmetic. External URL used: https://drive-showcase-28.preview.emergentagent.com
